name: salaty-by-nargiz
description: Salaty By Nargiz - Telegram Mini App, Admin Panel va Bot

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix miniapp && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,miniapp,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix miniapp" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --include=dev --prefix miniapp && npm ci --include=dev --prefix admin && npm run build --prefix miniapp && npm run build --prefix admin
